_doc: THE APP LINEUP FOR THE ~800-UNIT SELECT BUILD, and the file `tools/build.py` reads. `apps` is the launcher's grid order and `launcher` is the one directory under `apps/` that is not on the grid: the boot host, which hides itself, making 9 directories in all. The build refuses any directory this file does not name. Extracted by `scripts/export-source.py` from the repository's own `apps-roster.json`, which is the single source both exporters read -- the decision narrative behind each entry stays in the repository, and `excluded` here carries one compacted sentence per entry instead.

asset_profiles.note: Per-app payload pruning, and it governs `.gpa` deck files ONLY -- every module, icon, LUT and mask bank ships regardless, so nothing an app imports can go missing. A profile that kept zero decks would reset the badge at launch, which is why the exporter's `deck-assets-present` gate refuses one.

descriptions.badgecard: The wearable name badge and its editor: name, handle, marks and theme, edited on the badge with the QWERTY keyboard and saved to /state.
descriptions.flappy: POOLER.SQL, a tap-to-fly game about getting a query through the connection pool.
descriptions.glyph: An animated glyph viewer: 18 recorded techniques at two grid densities, A and C to step, B for the rear case lights.
descriptions.menu: The launcher. Boots the badge, draws the app grid, dims and opens the poster when idle, and plays the first-wake ceremony on a cold start.
descriptions.pet: A database pet that lives in a save file: it gets hungry, it gets bored, and it remembers how you treated it across reboots.
descriptions.poster: The badge, worn. Full-screen artwork, marks and name, and the resting state the launcher returns to after 30 seconds of nothing.
descriptions.schedule: The conference agenda, fully offline. Day tabs, session detail, and an honest clock: it says when it cannot trust the time instead of guessing.
descriptions.settings: The utility tile: backlight, sleep, and the pairing and network status screens. With BadgeLink off it shows Not ready and everything else still works.
descriptions.snake: Snake, drawn at 160x120 and pixel-doubled, which is the look the games all landed on. A and C steer relative to travel, UP and DOWN are absolute, and the walls wrap.

excluded.badgelink: Not a tile. BadgeLink's badge modules ship as bytecode in /system/lib (OWNER-DECISIONS #1) and are consumed by the settings tile; the badgelink app directory is its dev surface.
excluded.benchmark_app: Dev instrument. Also the one app that cannot be pure bytecode (@micropython.native in runner.py), so shipping it would put .py beside .mpy on a production badge.

excluded.extend_a_squirrel: RETIRED AND DELETED, 2026-08-21, by owner ruling: [quotation removed]. Pimoroni's own Snake, admitted 2026-08-20 as an unmodernised comparison specimen so the owner could judge their sprite-per-segment body against our merged tube.
excluded.glyph2x: RETIRED AS A TILE, 2026-08-21, by consolidation rather than by ruling: `glyph` is now ONE viewer carrying BOTH recorded decks, so there is no second app to ship. The 32x12 assets moved to `glyph/badge/glyph/assets2x/` and the entry point was deleted; `glyph2x/` keeps its host builders, its receipts and its asset/renderer tests, so the deck is still regenerable and still covered.
excluded.glyph2x_lab: Dev lab: the HIRES twin of glyph_lab.
excluded.glyph_1x_hi: DEV COMPARISON TILE, 2026-08-22, one of four: `glyph` at 16x6/HIRES, which is today's shipping default in isolation.
excluded.glyph_1x_lo: DEV COMPARISON TILE, 2026-08-22, one of four: `glyph` at 16x6/LORES, the pre-consolidation shipping look. The owner asked for four ISOLATED tiles so the density question can be judged on glass without the geometry changing under his thumb mid-A/B.
excluded.glyph_2x_hi: DEV COMPARISON TILE, 2026-08-22, one of four: `glyph` at 32x12/HIRES, the only configuration in the app where HIRES buys real detail, and the case the owner has never fairly seen -- his first A/B ran against a broken frame (wrong-geometry tiles, fixed 2026-08-21) and the flip that replaced it crashed on memory (fixed 2026-08-22).
excluded.glyph_2x_lo: DEV COMPARISON TILE, 2026-08-22, one of four: `glyph` at 32x12/LORES, which is the retired `glyph2x` app's exact mode and has had no tile since the 2026-08-21 consolidation. It is also the ONLY configuration anywhere that reaches the natively authored 5x10 mask bank (`assets2x/glyph-masks-2x.pfb`), which the density-flip report calls dead weight on a HIRES-only payload -- here it is live.

excluded.glyph_review: Dev lab: a review harness for the glyph decks, not a product tile.

excluded.snake2x: RETIRED AS A TILE, 2026-08-23, BY OWNER RULING -- the one entry here that was decided by a person playing the badge rather than by consolidation or a technique verdict. [quotation removed].
excluded.supervisor: NOT the shipping boot architecture. [repository record] §Product-state boundary: the product keeps the factory reset-per-app control flow, with no background network supervisor active.

system_lib.note: Whether `/system/lib` ships at all. It does not: the network runtime is dark in this build. `main.py` keeps its guarded import either way, so the badge boots offline and prints `BADGELINK_NETWORK boot=offline error=ImportError`; `settings` is the only app that guards a `/system/lib` import and it degrades to its "Not ready" view.
